title: Certificate body
description: The Academy's certificate (academy.md section 3, register rows DK25 and DK27): the Registrar attests that a holder passed an exam in a skill at a level. Signed by the Registrar (the envelope's issuer). Level 1 with skill foundations is the Foundations certificate; level 2 or more in another skill is a Practitioner certificate. A certificate lasts until expires; a tier already reached is not lost at expiry. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits never buy a certificate's standing.

exam_result.description: The exam result record or run-log hash this rests on. Until the exam engine exists the Registrar may leave it out.
